en: Color-tinted panoramic view of a small European town with red-roofed houses surrounded by dense greenery. A white church with a tall tower stands prominently in the center-right, while a large building complex (likely a castle or manor) appears on the left. In the foreground there are railway tracks and an old-style train carriage. The sky is clear and blue. German captions on the image label the town and specific landmarks.
